page_title: CEL 1-1 ATM | Celta Vigo v Atletico Madrid 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Marcos Alonso swings the cross over. Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
90+5' It looked like the long-range shot by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
90+4' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+3' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+2' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
90+1' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' That's unlucky! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.

87' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
86' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
85' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle as Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
85' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
84' Substitution. Borja Iglesias will be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
84' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) replacing Sergio Carreira.
83' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Giuliano Simeone.
81' A substitution has been made. Julian Alvarez is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
78' The referee gives a yellow card to Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid).
77' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Koke and he is replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
76' It will be a substitution. Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Javi Galan walks off.

74' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his low strike to the middle of the target as Jan Oblak produces a good save.
73' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
72' The referee awards a corner and Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take it.
72' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Ionut Radu has no trouble gathering it. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
68' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
65' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Here is a change. Williot Swedberg is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo).
63' Substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replaces Ferran Jutgla.
61' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
58' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Beltran departs the field of play to be replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
54' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
50' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
48' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
46' The attendance is 20877.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Javi Galan and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

44' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) latched on to an accurate pass just outside the box and immediately lashed the ball towards the top left corner. His effort was thwarted by Jan Oblak, who pulled off a stunning save. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
44' The ball is crossed into the box and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) reacts quickest to send a shot flying low towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak gets a glove on it to thwart him.
40' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!

39' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Julian Alvarez was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.

39' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
37' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
36' Wonderful movement by Celta Vigo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

34' A nice lofted cross finds David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
33' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
30' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
29' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) passes the ball onto Borja Iglesias, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
25' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
22' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
20' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
19' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
17' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

14' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
6' 0 - 1 What bad luck! Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 0:1.
4' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
2' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
1' The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
1' The first half has started.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
